observations: A used automotive AC compressor resting on dirt.
Multi-groove pulley attached to the front.
Label on the body is visible but the text is mostly illegible due to blur.
The text 'HFC134a' is readable on the label in photo 0.
Image contains a watermark 'OME COOLING VENTURES'.

claims.evidence: This suggests it is a 'tokunbo' part pulled from an engine, which cannot be verified via photo.
The part number on the label in photo 0 is too blurry to confirm compatibility with a Mercedes-Benz W166 GLE550.

risks.proof: A video showing the center hub of the pulley being turned easily by hand.
A clear, sharp photo of the manufacturer's label showing the part number.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic core of unknown fitment

risks.risk: Electrical control valve or clutch failure
risks.proof: A video showing a 12V 'click' test of the clutch or a multimeter reading of the solenoid.

proof_requests: Clear, close-up photo of the identification label showing the part number.
Video of the compressor hub being rotated by hand to ensure it is not seized.
Photo of the electrical connector pins to check for corrosion or damage.
response.reason: The identity and compatibility of the part cannot be confirmed because the label is unreadable. Furthermore, there is no evidence that the compressor is not seized.
